redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. Each unit covers distinct material themes: core financial results (K1), sales/presales dynamics (K2), project completions (K3), balance sheet position (K4), major corporate events (K5), post-period event (K6), and forward outlook (K7). No substantial overlap exists between any pair.

key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance for Q2 and H1 2026: Q2 revenue EUR 4,503k (Q2 2025: EUR 7,388k), Q2 profit before tax EUR -234k (Q2 2025: EUR 1,002k), Q2 net loss EUR 618k (Q2 2025: net profit EUR 974k); H1 revenue EUR 11,439k (H1 2025: EUR 9,319k), H1 profit before tax EUR 186k (H1 2025: EUR 296k), H1 net loss EUR 198k (H1 2025: net profit EUR 268k). Q2 loss impacted by EUR 384k income tax expense on dividends and ~EUR 90k offering-related costs.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview section; Consolidated statements of comprehensive income

key_information_units.information: Sales contract activity and presales growth: 57 sales contracts signed in Q2 2026 (Q2 2025: 31; including 3 in Berlin), 111 in H1 2026 (H1 2025: 56). Presale portfolio grew to EUR 48.6m across 171 contracts entering Q3 2026 (EUR 39.8m in 2026-completion projects). Presales exclude Phase I of the Peakorter project, as it is a 50/50 joint venture not consolidated line by line. Weekly sales ratio reached nearly 3.1% in Q2 vs long-term normal 1.5–2.0%, driven by Regati phase II, Iseära new phase, and Kadakadabra phase I presales. Market share exceeded 8% in Greater Tallinn during H1 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview section; Weekly sales ratio discussion

key_information_units.information: Home handovers and project completions: 12 homes handed over in Q2 2026 (Q2 2025: 35; Q1 2026: 14), totaling 26 homes/commercial units in H1 2026 (H1 2025: 41). Iseära: 1 home in phase II handed over in Q2; Regati: 9 homes handed over in Q2 (total sold and handed over 85 as of 30 June 2026).

Balance sheet position as of 30 June 2026: Cash and cash equivalents EUR 10,033k; Total assets EUR 100,186k; Total liabilities EUR 73,440k; Equity EUR 26,746k (up from EUR 18,431k as of 30 June 2025). Construction loans increased to EUR 16,561k by quarter-end.

Major corporate events: Completed IPO (23 April–7 May 2026), listing on Nasdaq Tallinn Main List on 15 May 2026, raising EUR 4,932k via 1,053,936 new shares at EUR 4.68/share. Approved and paid EUR 1,362k dividends from 2025 profit. Acquired two Berlin properties (Plantagenstraße 19: EUR 1.7m; Reichstraße 101: EUR 1.2m) for residential development.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview and Key events sections

key_information_units.information: Post-reporting period event: In July 2026, signed notarial contract to acquire development properties at Pärnu maantee 35/37/41 in Tallinn (transaction volume EUR 10m; estimated total project investment EUR 40m for >160 residential/commercial units).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Events after the reporting period section

key_information_units.information: Outlook: Nearly 90% of 2026 revenue target (EUR 59m) covered by contracts and presales as of H1 end. Expect H2 revenue and net profit growth, targeting >20% ROE. Plan to start construction in five project phases in H2 2026 (including Kadakadabra and Juhkentali), supporting 2027 results. Construction loan volume expected to peak in Q3 before decreasing with 2026 completions.
